target_customer: DTC ecommerce brands, especially physical goods sellers with reorder or cross-sell potential, that pay per conversation volume
problem: Brands lose repeat revenue and handle returns poorly because post-purchase contact over SMS and email is ignored, while shoppers do read and answer iMessage.
business_model: B2B usage-based, priced by expected conversation volume and channels, with ROI proposal before launch
product_category: AI store associate and iMessage conversational commerce

founders.name: Ilya Valmianski
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a second-time founder; education other than the PhD not listed.

founders.name: Alejandro Zaniolo
previous_startups: A startup that grew to $40M ARR before he left
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Postscript, Attentive, Klaviyo SMS
competitors.what: SMS and marketing messaging for Shopify brands

competitors.name: Blooio, Linq, SendBlue (iMessage APIs)
competitors.what: iMessage sending APIs usable for ecommerce post-purchase flows

technical_complexity.rationale: An AI conversation layer on top of iMessage and Shopify integrations is standard engineering with hard parts around iMessage delivery, consent compliance and measuring incremental revenue.

defensibility.rationale: Several vendors already pitched iMessage for ecommerce in 2026 and the AI layer is copyable; integration depth with Shopify and helpdesks gives only mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Klaviyo launched RCS for Business in February 2026; no source shows incumbents copying the specific iMessage conversation product by the time of research.

market_need_then: Shoppers read iMessage more than email or SMS marketing, ecommerce faces TCPA scrutiny in 2026, and brands want repeat revenue. Company claims about $30 incremental revenue per conversation and 58 percent reply rate are self reported and unverified.

branding.domain_note: Product site at returnsignals.com; YC slug is signals. Launched as Return Signals, legal entity reported as Material Model, Inc. by one aggregator.

identity.visual_style: Plain, modern landing page with italic emphasis words

rebrands.why: Not stated; the YC page and website show both names.

brand_strength.rationale: Only first party pages and aggregators describe the brand; the shortened name Signals is generic and collides with many other companies, and no press about the brand was found.

pivots.from: Proactive post-delivery returns support by SMS concierge (Return Signals launch)
pivots.to: iMessage revenue channel and AI store associate
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from the change of positioning between the launch post and the YC one liner.

outcome_analysis: Signals is a two person Winter 2026 company with no public exit, shutdown or confirmed funding. Its YC one liner moved from returns support to repeat revenue through iMessage, and the market has several iMessage and SMS vendors, so durability depends on proving incremental revenue and compliance. Too early for an outcome verdict.
notes: Funding aggregators disagree and no company or press source confirms any round, so no round is recorded. Unverified single aggregator figures: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed Jan 2026 with YC as investor; YesPress describes $130K seed. Founder education of Zaniolo not found. Company metrics are self reported.
